name: Prism Bloom
description: Cinematic highlight bloom that softly diffuses bright areas with an adjustable color halo.
author: maxzzzzzzzzzzzz

parameters.name: Highlight Threshold
parameters.description: Sets the brightness level at which pixels begin to emit bloom.

parameters.name: Diffusion
parameters.description: Controls the radius of the soft light spread in pixels.

parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.description: Controls the brightness of the bloom over the original image.

parameters.name: Glow Color
parameters.description: Sets the color toward which the emitted light is tinted.

parameters.name: Color Blend
parameters.description: Mixes the source highlight color with the selected glow color.

parameters.name: Halo
parameters.description: Controls the wider, softer ring around the strongest highlights.

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.description: Controls the opacity of the bloom layer while preserving the base image.
